title: Machine learning finds ferroptosis genes Atf3 and Piezo1 in spinal cord injury
summary: Random forest and LASSO applied to bulk and single-cell RNA-seq data (GSE47681, GSE5296, GSE162610) identified Atf3 and Piezo1 as key ferroptosis genes after spinal cord injury, linked to macrophage/microglia states. Docking indicated the encoded proteins bind cycloheximide. In a mouse T8 spinal cord injury model, low-dose cycloheximide improved neurological function and shifted macrophage/microglia markers (lower inducible nitric oxide synthase, higher arginase 1, higher Gpx4, lower Acsl4). Mouse preclinical study; binding supported by docking only.
ai_technology: Random forest and LASSO key-gene selection on bulk and single-cell RNA-seq
organization: Tianjin Medical University General Hospital; Tianjin Medical University

evidence.tested: Cycloheximide treatment in a mouse T8 spinal cord injury model with neurological and marker readouts.
evidence.unknown: Human relevance and direct binding measurements; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selects key ferroptosis-related genes that guided the drug hypothesis.
